_how_to: Copy to a file and set PSEMU_EXT_POLICY=<path>. First matching rule wins. Run once with no policy, read the [ext] lines / exit report, then pin what matters. Unlisted objects keep the old behaviour.
_fields: name (glob), kind evf|sema|any, action satisfy|block|timeout, bits (evf: owner's bits), signals (sema: assumed grants, -1 = unlimited), timed (sema: also grant timed waits), note

_examples.name: SceBootStatusFlags
_examples.note: REPLACE 0x0 with the bits that mean 'booted OK' once you've read the guest's handling
